ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, berries are a food source for what animal?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the food web there is a picture of berries labeled “berries”; near the berries, a food web arrow can be seen pointing from berries to the animal picture labeled “Red Panda” at the lower left. Reasoning: The arrows in this food web indicate that a food source points to the organism that eats this kind of food. Therefore, berries are the food source of Red Panda.
